Analysis.description: Which of the source's results exist, for the page's finding and its waiting words.

cast.description: who is in each scene is known (the people are named, or skipped)
cast.title: Cast

transcript.description: None for a source with no sound
transcript.title: Transcript

Analysis.title: Analysis

AnswerIn.description:
The person's answer for a group of a tape's face tracks: name them (a new person called `name`, or `person`, known
already), say they are not faces, or skip them.
AnswerIn.title: AnswerIn

Approval.description:
The body of an approval: `value` is kept with it (the choice made, the policy judged by). A request body, so a
plain BaseModel (`contracts.ApiModel` would give the schema an -Input and an -Output twin).
Approval.title: Approval

Chapter.description:
A run of neighbouring scenes of one occasion (`chapters.group`): its place on the tape, its scenes, how sure the
boundary that starts it is and why, and its name (`None` before the name step has run for it).

confidence.description: that the boundary before it starts a chapter; None for the first
confidence.title: Confidence

reasons.description: why the boundary before it is one, in words
reasons.title: Reasons

title.description: the person's title for it, which wins over the name's; None for none
title.title: Title

Chapter.title: Chapter

ChapterName.description:
strata-models' name for a chapter (preset `chapter-name-v1`): what its scenes show kept apart from what is
guessed, and whether they look like more than one occasion.

mixed.description: the scenes look like more than one occasion: the grouping is in doubt
mixed.title: Mixed

ChapterName.title: ChapterName

Clash.description: Something the person asked that the plan could not keep; `override` is the constraint, None for the length.
Clash.title: Clash

Clip.description:
A clip occurrence: `start` and `end` are the exact half-open source range (mediatime text, on frames), the
seconds beside them are for the page; `at_seconds` is where it starts in the reel.

id.description: the occurrence's own id: the same range keeps it from one revision to the next
id.title: Id

scene.description: the start of the scene it was cut from, exact
scene.title: Scene

Clip.title: Clip

ConstraintIn.description: A pin or ban names a scene (from 0, the tape's scenes now), a lock a clip of one of the reel's revisions.
ConstraintIn.title: ConstraintIn

ConstraintOut.description: A pin, ban or lock that holds: the span it names (a scene's for a pin or ban, the clip's for a lock).

clip.description: the locked clip's id; None for a pin or ban
clip.title: Clip

ConstraintOut.title: ConstraintOut

Described.description: A source as the API and the CLI show it.
Described.title: Described

Description.description:
strata-models' description of a scene (preset `scene-describe-v2`): what is seen kept apart from what is
guessed, each guess with its evidence.

who.description: who does what (preset v3; empty before it)
who.title: Who

Description.title: Description

Folder.description: A folder the app uses, and the disk it is on (None when the folder does not exist yet).
Folder.title: Folder

Frame.description:
A picture of the scene at `time` seconds; `url` is a path from the app's root, which the page puts its base before
(`api.url`), as for every request.
Frame.title: Frame

Group.description:
Tracks that look like one person, nobody's yet: name it, say it is not faces, or skip it. An answer may be
given for some of its tracks only (the grouping put two people together): the rest stay open and are grouped again.

faces.description: the face store's ids of a few of its stills, best first, for crops
faces.title: Faces

first.description: when its first track starts, seconds into the tape
first.title: First

seconds.description: how long its faces are on screen, all its tracks together
seconds.title: Seconds

stills.description: every track of the group by its best still, the longest first
stills.title: Stills

Group.title: Group

InScene.description: Someone the family named, seen in a scene.

seconds.description: how long their face is on screen in the scene
seconds.title: Seconds

InScene.title: InScene

Known.description: A person the face store knows, to add a group to.
Known.title: Known

MarkIn.description:
Whether a chapter starts at the scene: True starts one, False keeps it with the chapter before, None leaves it
to the grouping (the mark taken back).
MarkIn.title: MarkIn

Peaks.description: The source's sound as the lowest and highest sample of each slice, -1 to 1, over `seconds`.
Peaks.title: Peaks

People.description:
The tape's faces as the People tab shows them. `waiting` says, in a sentence, what they wait for while there are
none yet; `done` is the person's word that the naming is finished (the gate).

hidden.description: tracks whose faces are all too small or unsure to name
hidden.title: Hidden

People.title: People

face.description: one of their stills here, for a crop
face.title: Face

PlanIn.description: Plan the reel again: another seed for another version, or another length (which becomes the reel's).
PlanIn.title: PlanIn

Progress.description: How far a task has got. `total` None means not known yet; `text` is the line a person reads ("Page 3 of 40").
Progress.title: Progress

open.description: proposals not accepted or rejected, newest first (stale ones too)
open.title: Open

proposals.description: proposals that can still be accepted
proposals.title: Proposals

ReelIn.description: A new reel of a tape: its length in seconds, and a name (else the tape's and the length).
ReelIn.title: ReelIn

ReelOut.description: A reel in the list: its current revision's length and clip count (None before one is accepted).

proposals.description: proposals that can still be accepted
proposals.title: Proposals

ReelOut.title: ReelOut

RenderOut.description: A render of a revision: its job's state while it is made, then its file. `url` downloads it once `done`.

error.description: why the job failed, in its words
error.title: Error

manifest.description: what made the file (spec S8); None until it is made
manifest.title: Manifest

url.description: the file, relative to the app's base; None until it is made
url.title: Url

RenderOut.title: RenderOut

RevisionOut.description:
One revision of a reel. `state`: `proposal` (can be accepted), `stale` (made on a revision that is no longer the
current one: plan again), `current`, `past` (was current) or `rejected`.
RevisionOut.title: RevisionOut

Scene.description:
One scene: its place on the tape, how sure the cut that starts it is, and what step 3 found about it (`None`
where that job has not run yet).

confidence.description: that the cut before it starts a scene; None for the first
confidence.title: Confidence

faces.description: the most faces on any one of its keyframes; None before the faces step
faces.title: Faces

mark.description: the person's word on whether a chapter starts at it: True starts one, False keeps it with the chapter before, None leaves it to the grouping
mark.title: Mark

people.description: the named people seen in it, longest first; None before the cast
people.title: People

reasons.description: why the cut before it is a boundary, in words
reasons.title: Reasons

speech.description: what is said in it (doubtful segments left out); None before the transcript
speech.title: Speech

Scene.title: Scene

Scenes.description:
A source's scenes as the browser shows them. `waiting` says, in a sentence, what the scenes wait for while there
are none yet.

chapters.description: None before the scenes are grouped into chapters
chapters.title: Chapters

regrouping.description: the person's marks are newer than the chapters shown: they are being grouped again
regrouping.title: Regrouping

Scenes.title: Scenes

doubtful.description: Whisper itself doubts it is speech
doubtful.title: Doubtful

ServiceStatus.description: Another strata service this app calls, as its health endpoint answered just now.
ServiceStatus.title: ServiceStatus

StageEvent.description:
One record of a stage: `status` done, failed or cleared; `by` who approved a gate or cleared it; `data` the
stage's answer (or a gate's value), sent only where one stage's history is asked for.
StageEvent.title: StageEvent

StageRun.description: A stage of a pipeline as one subject stands: what a step list on screen draws, a row per stage.
StageRun.title: StageRun

share.description: of the confirmed faces nearest the group, the part that are this person's
share.title: Share

Task.description: A job or task row as an API answers it.
Task.title: Task

TitleIn.description: The person's title for a chapter; None goes back to the name the namer gave it.
TitleIn.title: TitleIn

TrackStill.description: One track of a group, by its best still: what the person picks when a group holds more than one person.

face.description: the face store's id of the track's best still, for a crop
face.title: Face

TrackStill.title: TrackStill

Transcript.description: The whole source's speech, or no segments with `waiting` set before the transcript step has run.
Transcript.title: Transcript

Video.description: The first video stream, as the editor needs it.
Video.title: Video

person.description: a name the family gave, or who they are (a woman, a boy of about five)
person.title: Person

WorkflowRun.description: One subject's way through one pipeline, and the queue job advancing it now (or the last one), if any.
WorkflowRun.title: WorkflowRun
